_note: Candidate registry for Tennessee 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Elections, Candidate Lists: Candidates for Governor, United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, November 3, 2026 General Election (PDF and Excel files created September 3, 2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Elections, Candidate Lists: Candidates for Governor, United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, November 3, 2026 General Election (PDF and Excel files created September 3, 2026) (https://sos.tn.gov/elections/2026-candidate-lists); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
